title: Mitigating Model Collapse through Dreaming Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.30009v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training generative models on synthetic data causes loss of diversity and a decrease in performance, a phenomenon known as model collapse. We study this degeneration spectrally in a controlled Markov setting. The eigenvalue spectrum of the learned transition operator offers a direct view of the process, since the subdominant eigenvalues set how fast the chain mixes and therefore how much of the state space it continues to explore. We find that sampling at temperature $T_s < 1$ acts on the operator like repeated sharpening, pushing it toward a deterministic system: the subdominant eigenvalues approach the unit circle and the spectral gap narrows. When $T_s < 1$, even data accumulation does not appear to arrest this drift. We then analyze Dreaming Learning, a regulariser that, in parallel with regular training, adds a loss term on the model's own samples drawn at a raised temperature $T_d > 1$. translated_title: 通过梦境学习缓解模型坍塌
translated_abstract: 在合成数据上训练生成模型会导致多样性丧失和性能下降，这一现象被称为模型坍塌。我们在受控的马尔可夫环境中从谱分析的角度研究这种退化。学习到的转移算子的特征值谱为该过程提供了直接的观察视角，因为次主导特征值决定了马尔可夫链的混合速度，进而决定了模型对状态空间的持续探索程度。我们发现，在温度 Ts < 1 下采样对转移算子的作用类似于反复锐化，会将其推向一个确定性系统：次主导特征值趋近于单位圆，谱隙收窄。当 Ts < 1 时，即使是数据累积似乎也无法阻止这种漂移。随后我们分析了梦境学习，这是一种正则化方法，它在常规训练的同时，对模型以较高温度 Td > 1 采样生成的自身样本添加一个损失项。由于高温样本会平滑……
tldr: 该论文从谱分析角度揭示低温采样（Ts < 1）会使转移算子锐化、谱隙收窄从而导致模型坍塌，并提出“梦境学习”正则化方法——在训练中对模型以高温生成的自身样本施加额外损失项——来缓解这一退化。
en_tdlr: This paper spectrally shows that low-temperature sampling (Ts < 1) sharpens the transition operator and narrows the spectral gap, causing model collapse, and proposes "Dreaming Learning," a regularizer that adds a loss term on the model's own high-temperature samples to mitigate this degeneration.
